change: Capture records formatted label text and immutable style in image metadata. Label replay accepts saved text without reevaluating live labels and restores the processor configuration after success/failure. OpenCV focus labels now use initialized text_xy coordinates.

proof: Normal Pillow/OpenCV output matches frozen baseline methods pixel-for-pixel.
Replay retains identical pixels after live text/style changes; a fail-on-call mock proves no live label evaluation.
Empty text is distinct from missing text; disabled/focus states clear stale text.
Focus OpenCV no longer reads uninitialized image_xy; focus output replays identically.
Invalid/incomplete snapshots are rejected; original configuration/focus restored after rendering failure.

deployment: Not deployed. Production remains 0cf2de6e/application 994ac136; no capture restart or format-policy change.
limits: Label replay requires the recorded font asset and original exposure time for focus mode.
This does not implement full FITS replay, source cache, source-aware media generators or day/night archival settings.
Label metadata currently persists with the image record; complete portable post-processing context still needs integration.
